purpose: Verify a model suggestion, human review, explicit approval and linked BID/ASK historical comparison; no strategy search
execution: Existing SMA BID/ASK engine unchanged; next observed session first-hour open, buy ASK, sell/mark BID, no forced final close
permission: Model suggestions have no execution authority. Preserve exact strategy and windows; user-facing review selects source and money assumptions; saving does not execute; a separate approval reserves the comparison.
model_failure: Preserve any failure and its reservation; no automatic retry, no silent EMA/SMA substitution. Manual review is available and must be reported as manual if used.
budget: Use existing persisted 24 model requests and four comparisons shared with BCE; do not increase or reset limits
price_integrity: Verify originals at review, approval and execution; preserve input copies and approval; reject stale source or engine
queries: No model calls, strategy execution or account processing on GET
scope: Retrospective known-history integration check, not prospective validation or strategy selection
